Markets.title: India bonds reverse intraday gains to end lower as profit booking takes center stage
Markets.summary: Indian government bonds fell as traders engaged in profit-taking after earlier gains, pushing the benchmark yield up to 7.2858%. Additionally, fluctuations in crude prices and rising retail inflation have led analysts to predict a potential interest rate increase by the Reserve Bank of India in December.

Markets.title: PI Industries among 5 stocks hitting 52-week low; slipped up to 26% in a month
Markets.summary: Five BSE 500 stocks, including PI Industries, Aditya Birla Fashion and Retail, and Thermax, hit fresh 52-week lows amid a weakening market. These stocks experienced monthly losses of up to 26 percent.

Markets.title: Rupee ends flat after hitting seven-month high as firmer dollar offsets inflows
SpiceJet board approves up to Rs 5,500 crore fundraise amid operational challenges; stock hits 5% upper circuit
Markets.summary: SpiceJet's board has approved a fundraising plan of up to Rs 5,500 crore as the airline struggles with recent operational disruptions and flight cancellations. Despite these challenges, the company's shares hit a five percent upper circuit for the sixth consecutive session.

Markets.title: Govt weighs tax tweaks to boost stock trading, curb derivatives: Report
Markets.summary: The Indian government is reviewing proposals to cut the securities transaction tax on cash equities by 50% and reduce long-term capital gains tax while raising levies on derivatives. These recommendations aim to curb speculative trading and encourage broader market participation ahead of the 2027 Budget.

Markets.title: How Ashish Kacholia, Radhakishan Damani, Madhusudan Kela and other ace investors reshuffled their portfolios in Q2
Markets.summary: During the September quarter, prominent investors Mukul Agrawal, Akash Bhanshali, and Ashish Kacholia saw the largest gains in their portfolio values. In contrast, Radhakishan Damani experienced the steepest decline in his portfolio value during the same period.

Geo-Political.title: Trump shakes hands with Putin and Xi ahead of historic talks in China
Geo-Political.summary: Donald Trump, Vladimir Putin, and Xi Jinping will shake hands before meeting together for the first time on Thursday. The three world leaders are gathering in China for a closely-watched historic summit.

Geo-Political.title: Nvidia says it won't reinstate Huang as it reports soaring sales
Geo-Political.summary: Nvidia reported soaring quarterly sales on Tuesday following the dramatic exit of Jensen Huang. The company stated that it will not reinstate Huang as its leader.

Geo-Political.title: Bancroft sandpaper claims heap pressure on Cummins
Geo-Political.summary: Cameron Bancroft claimed that the entire Australian cricket team knew about the 2018 ball-tampering plot. These revelations place increased pressure on current Test captain Pat Cummins.

Geo-Political.title: Democrats win Alaska Senate race two weeks after midterms counting began
Geo-Political.summary: Democrat Mary Peltola won the Alaska Senate race two weeks after midterm counting began. Her victory completed the Democratic party's success in the midterm Senate elections.

Geo-Political.title: Can a US-backed mineral highway bring peace and prosperity to DR Congo?
Geo-Political.summary: The US-backed Lobito Corridor project aims to secure access to critical minerals in the Democratic Republic of Congo. Proponents hope this infrastructure initiative will bring peace and economic prosperity to the region.

Geo-Political.title: British hacker who stole $11m through text message scheme jailed for six years in US
Geo-Political.summary: Tyler Buchanan, a British member of the Scattered Spider hacking group from Dundee, was sentenced to six years in a US prison. He was convicted for his role in a text message scheme that stole $11 million.

AI & Tech.title: REA: The Open-Source AI Tool That Can Reverse Engineer Almost Anything (2026 Guide)
AI & Tech.summary: REA is a new open-source AI tool designed to reverse engineer applications without requiring access to source code. This tool eliminates the need for months of learning disassemblers and reading assembly code to understand how apps are built.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: An experiment showed that an author's WordPress course was recommended as the top result by ChatGPT for a specific query without paid advertising. This outcome highlights a shift in organic traffic generation toward AI optimization over traditional search engine optimization.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Tools That Will Transform Your Content Creation in 2025
AI & Tech.summary: This guide highlights the top 10 AI tools designed to help creators improve their digital content creation in 2025. These essential technologies are revolutionizing the industry and simplifying workflows for creators.

AI & Tech.title: LimeWire AI Studio Review 2023: Details, Pricing & Features
AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire has launched an AI Studio that functions as a generative content platform. The tool allows users to create, share, and monetize AI-generated content.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Tools in 2023 That Will Make Your Life Easier
AI & Tech.summary: This article highlights the top 10 artificial intelligence tools of 2023 that

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Content Generator & Writer Tools in 2022
AI & Tech.summary: This article lists the top 10 AI content generator and writer tools available in 2022. It explains that these tools help users efficiently create engaging and relevant content for their audiences.

Data & Insights.title: Trump, Xi, Putin unite $1.48 Trillion military might at Shenzhen: Will nukes be on the table? Why it matters
Data & Insights.summary: US President Donald Trump has arrived in Shenzhen, China, to attend the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit. On Thursday, he is scheduled to hold a high-stakes meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin.

Data & Insights.title: Soybean oil's share rises in India's edible oil import mix
Data & Insights.summary: India imported 5.83 million tonnes of soybean oil during the 2025-26 period. This accounted for a rising share of the country's total edible oil imports of 16.92 million tonnes.

Data & Insights.title: Could AI boom trigger a jobs crisis? The risks Fed Chair Kevin Warsh sees beyond productivity gains
Data & Insights.summary: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh warns that the AI boom could cause widespread job displacement through automation. Alternatively, he notes it may drive faster economic growth or trigger an economic slowdown if market expectations are not met.

Data & Insights.title: Union Budget 2027-28: FICCI seeks graded LTCG taxation,  ₹100 lakh crore in credit for manufacturing growth
Data & Insights.summary: FICCI has recommended restoring the long-term capital gains tax exemption on listed securities for the Union Budget 2027-28. The industry body is also advocating for a calibrated increase in the securities transaction tax.

Data & Insights.title: Mint Explainer: What FM's pre-budget stakeholder consultations mean
Data & Insights.summary: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman is holding pre-budget consultations with industry leaders, bankers, and experts over the coming days. This year's meetings will also include young people and retired bureaucrats for the first time.

Data & Insights.title: Budget 2027: Economists oppose LTCG tax cut as industry seeks abolition; what they told Sitharaman
Data & Insights.summary: Ahead of Budget 2027-28, economists advised Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman to retain the Long Term Capital Gains (LTCG) tax on equities. This recommendation directly opposes the industry's demand for the complete abolition of the tax.

India.title: "Over A Tea Or Something": Columbia Student's Offer To Rahul Gandhi, Whom She "Manifested", At US Event
India.summary: During a US event, Columbia University student and Delhi native Ridhi Kapoor pitched her solution for New Delhi's air pollution to Rahul Gandhi. She also invited him out for tea to discuss the matter further.

India.title: School Winter Vacation 2026: State-Wise Holiday Dates Students And Parents Need To Know
India.summary: Students and parents should check their school holiday calendars for the 2026 winter vacation dates. They are also advised to confirm these specific holiday schedules directly with their class teachers.

India.title: GRAP III Curbs Revoked In Delhi-NCR As Air Quality Improves
India.summary: Delhi-NCR has revoked the GRAP III pollution restrictions following an improvement in the region's air quality. These curbs were originally implemented on November 7, just before Diwali, when air quality levels plummeted.

India.title: Remove 'Adopted' Tag From Children's Official Records: Kerala High Court
India.summary: The Kerala High Court ruled that the "adopted" tag should be removed from children's official records. The decision followed a woman's petition asking to be legally recognized simply as her father's daughter rather than his adopted daughter.

India.title: Voice Choking At Cabinet Meeting, PM Modi Calls For Ending Drug Menace
India.summary: Prime Minister Modi became emotional during a cabinet meeting while urging officials to eradicate the drug menace in India. He argued that the country can successfully eliminate drug abuse just as it has tackled Naxalism.

India.title: Bengaluru Gets 1st Chief Commissioner In Major Reshuffle Of Karnataka Police
India.summary: Karnataka police implemented a major reshuffle appointing Bengaluru's first Chief Commissioner. Under this new structure, five commissioners will manage different parts of the city under the Chief Commissioner's supervision.

General.title: Typical energy bill forecast to go up by £443 a year from January as inflation rate rises again
General.summary: Typical annual energy bills are forecast to increase by £443 starting in January due to rising inflation. Inflation rose to 3.6% in October, marking the fourth consecutive monthly increase and remaining above the Bank of England's 2% target.

General.title: Trump shakes hands with Putin and Xi ahead of historic talks in China
General.summary: U.S. President Trump shook hands with Russian President Putin and Chinese President Xi ahead of their historic summit in China. The three leaders are scheduled to meet together for the first time on Thursday.

General.title: Watch: Why historic US, China and Russia meeting matters
General.summary: BBC journalists Laura Bicker, Steve Rosenberg, and Nada Tawfik explain the significance of an unprecedented trilateral meeting between the US, China, and Russia. The video details what people need to know ahead of this historic diplomatic gathering.

General.title: Minister criticises media for 'amplifying' Russell Brand's prison message
General.summary: Minister Lucy Powell criticized media outlets for broadcasting a recorded message from jailed rapist Russell Brand. She stated that the media should not have amplified the clip, which was read by his wife.

General.title: What's gone wrong at Britain's worst bathing site?
General.summary: Despite a dry summer with minimal sewage spills, a British bathing site failed numerous water quality tests. The BBC investigates the underlying reasons for this persistent failure.

General.title: Banned player says whole Australia team knew about sandpaper cheating plot
General.summary: Banned cricketer Cameron Bancroft claims the entire Australian team knew about the 2018 sandpaper cheating plot. These revelations place renewed pressure on current captain Pat Cummins.
